subtitle.en: A new island snapshot; the biggest visible changes are in the forest and beach on the left.
subtitle.zh: 一张新的岛屿快照；最明显的变化在左侧的森林和海滩。

blocks.en: It's been a while since the previous post, so here's a new island snapshot.
blocks.zh: 距上一篇帖子已经有一阵子了，所以这里发一张新的岛屿快照。

blocks.en: Most of what we've been working on lately is not visible in this shot, though! The biggest obvious changes are probably in the forest and beach on the left-hand side.
blocks.zh: 不过，我们最近做的大部分工作在这张图里都看不到！最明显的变化大概是左侧的森林和海滩。
